summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a commitlint configuration (index.js is a 12-line rules export) but its package.json defines a `preinstall` hook running `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against `math_init.js`, a 727KB heavily obfuscated file shipped in the tarball. The loader itself uses hex-prefixed variable names, and the payload uses a shuffled numeric-index string array rotator (`WV8StW`) with hex-encoded constants. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching a second runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload on install, evading Node-based static instrumentation. A static commitlint config has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime, a 727KB payload, obfuscation, or install-time code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
